name: Low Earth Orbit
description: A near-Earth orbit suited to short-duration observation and technology demonstrations.
tooltip: Low Earth Orbit (LEO): approximately 160-2,000 km altitude.

name: Sun-Synchronous Orbit
description: A near-polar orbit that provides repeatable local solar time for Earth observation.
tooltip: A sun-synchronous orbit revisits locations under similar lighting conditions.

name: Lunar Transfer
description: A transfer trajectory from Earth orbit toward the Moon, requiring additional spacecraft propulsion.
tooltip: Lunar transfer requires substantially more spacecraft delta-v than Earth orbit.
